mapper.select: SELECT A.CD as cd , A.NM as nm , STRING_AGG(B.NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.CD) AS nms FROM TB_SECT_INF A --INNER JOIN TB_PU_INFO B ON B.PARENT_CD = A.CD left outer JOIN TB_PU_INFO B ON B.PARENT_CD = A.CD GROUP BY A.CD, A.NM order by cd asc
SELECT A.cd as puCd , A.nm as puNm , A.parent_cd as parentCd , B.NM as parentNm FROM TB_PU_INFO A inner join TB_SECT_INF B on B.CD = A.CD WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT cd as waveCd , nm as waveNm , tat_start as tatStart
FROM TB_WAVE_INFO WHERE 1 = 1

WITH LIST AS ( SELECT A.LOT_ID as lotId , A.STD_DT as stdDt , A.OPER as oper
, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '00' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS tPgIn , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '01' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS tNoGwang , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '02' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS t1stA , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '03' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS t1stA2 , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '04' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS t1stB , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '05' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS t1stB2 , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '06' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS t2nd , MIN(CASE WHEN B.OPER IN ('07', '08') THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS tAdd , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '09' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END) AS [end]
, ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '00' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '01' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS vPgIn , ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '01' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '02' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS vNoGwang , ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '02' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '03' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS v1stA , ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '03' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '04' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS v1stA2 , ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '04' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '05' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS v1stB , ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '05' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '06' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS v1stB2 , ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '06' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MIN(CASE WHEN B.OPER IN ('07', '08') THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS v2nd , ROUND(CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MIN(CASE WHEN B.OPER IN ('07', '08') THEN B.OPER_START_TM END), MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPER = '09' THEN B.OPER_START_TM END)) AS FLOAT) / 1440.0, 2) AS vAdd
, A.LOT_CREATE_TM as lotCreateTm , A.LOT_OUT_TM as lotOutTm FROM TB_LOT A INNER JOIN TB_LOT_HISTORY B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND B.OPER <= A.OPER GROUP BY A.LOT_ID, A.STD_DT, A.OPER, A.LOT_CREATE_TM, A.LOT_OUT_TM ) SELECT B.lotId ,B.stdDt ,A.LOT_INFO as lotInfo ,a.wave ,B.oper ,A.site ,C.NM AS siteNm ,A.tech ,D.NM AS techNm ,A.equip ,E.NM AS equipNm ,B.tPgIn ,B.tNoGwang ,B.t1stA ,B.t1stA2 ,B.t1stB ,B.t1stB2 ,B.t2nd ,B.tAdd ,B.[end] ,B.vPgIn ,B.vNoGwang ,B.v1stA ,B.v1stA2 ,B.v1stB ,B.v1stB2 ,B.v2nd ,B.vAdd ,B.lotCreateTm ,B.lotOutTm FROM LIST B INNER JOIN TB_LOT A ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOTID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_INFO C ON A.SITE = C.CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TECH_INF D ON A.TECH = D.CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_EQUIP_INF E ON A.EQUIP = E.CD ORDER BY B.lotId

SELECT #{year} AS year, W.CD AS waveCd, W.NM AS waveNm, ISNULL(T.FAB_IN, 0) AS fabIn, ISNULL(T.B1ST, 0) AS b1st, ISNULL(T.B2ST, 0) AS b2st, ISNULL(T.B3ST, 0) AS b3st, ISNULL(T.B4ST, 0) AS b4st, ISNULL(T.B5ST, 0) AS b5st, ISNULL(T.PG_IN, 0) AS pgin, ISNULL(T.A1ST, 0) AS a1st, ISNULL(T.A2ST, 0) AS a2st, ISNULL(T.A3ST, 0) AS a3st, ISNULL(T.A4ST, 0) AS a4st, ISNULL(T.A5ST, 0) AS a5st, ISNULL(T.FAB_OUT, 0) AS fabOut FROM TB_WAVE_INFO W LEFT JOIN TB_KPI_TARGET T ON W.CD = T.WAVE_CD AND T.KPI_YEAR = #{year} ORDER BY CASE W.CD WHEN 'EUV' THEN 1 WHEN 'Arf_I' THEN 2 WHEN 'Arf_F' THEN 3 WHEN 'GUV' THEN 4 WHEN 'OUV' THEN 5 WHEN 'SUV' THEN 6 WHEN 'RUV' THEN 7 END
SELECT HIST_ID AS histId , KPI_YEAR AS kpiYear , CHG_REASON AS chgReason , HIST_REG_DT AS histRegDt , MOD_USER AS modUser FROM TB_KPI_TARGET_HIST_MASTER

SELECT HIST_ID AS histId , WAVE_CD AS waveCd , FAB_IN AS fabIn , B1ST AS b1st , B2ST AS b2st , B3ST AS b3st , B4ST AS b4st , B5ST AS b5st , PG_IN AS pgin , A1ST AS a1st , A2ST AS a2st , A3ST AS a3st , A4ST AS a4st , A5ST AS a5st , FAB_OUT AS fabOut , REG_DT AS regDt , REG_USER AS regUser FROM TB_KPI_TARGET_HIST_DETAIL WHERE 1=1 AND HIST_ID = #{histId}

SELECT [YEAR] AS year , KPI_CD AS kpiCd , KPI_NM AS kpiNm , GUBUN_VAL AS gubunVal , GUBUN_SIGN AS gubunSign , KPI_VAL AS kpiVal , [1st_Sign] AS v1stSign , [1st_Val] AS v1stVal , [1st_Mon] AS v1stMon , [1st_UseYn] AS v1stUseYn , [2st_Sign] AS v2stSign , [2st_Val] AS v2stVal , [2st_Mon] AS v2stMon , [2st_UseYn] AS v2stUseYn , [3st_Sign] AS v3stSign , [3st_Val] AS v3stVal , [3st_Mon] AS v3stMon , [3st_UseYn] AS v3stUseYn , [4st_Sign] AS v4stSign , [4st_Val] AS v4stVal , [4st_Mon] AS v4stMon , [4st_UseYn] AS v4stUseYn , REG_ID AS regId , REG_DT AS regDt , MOD_ID AS modId , MOD_DT AS modDt FROM tb_kpi_m WHERE 1=1 order by kpicd asc
